message:
Improved progression balance so upgrades and milestones feel smoother and more rewarding.
Added clearer milestone tracking to help players see what goal is coming next.
Updated Soul Boss encounters with better visual feedback and overall polish.
Reworked parts of damage and upgrade scaling for a more consistent gameplay curve.
Fixed multiple gameplay bugs, including quest progress, offline rewards, and equipment behavior.
Improved overall stability and reliability with broader internal testing and fixes.
